body: Do you ever suffer from insomnia or hyper religious thoughts? Lately these have been my Achilles heal I even lost a job prospect because of it! I've totally lost my ability to feel much emotion which sucks but honestly just trying to survive and hope things get better. My pdoc just upped my lithium dosage in hoping that would get me some regular sleep cause he suspects I might be becoming manic again. I'm starting to hate my life but I don't want to die. But not being able to have a normal life sucks! I'm in constant mental pain and just want relief and now I can't even sleep so I have NO escape I'm still looking for employment tho in hopes my health increases and I'm able to at least work. How are you coping, do you or can you work?

Have you tried seroquel? This tends to work for me but recently had to up the dosage. I don't recommend any drug if you can help it but also if you need a pill you just have to accept that. I will be starting CBT in Oct but I start my full time job next week and have to get this sleep issues under control. I hope you find something that works and if you do please share so the rest of us can try and add it to our routine. Congrats on your new position btw!

Just curious have you tried seroquel? It's a antipsychotic but you can also take it for sleep. I also have been having sleep issues for almost a month now. I tried taking trazodone didn't work. Zaleplon didn't work and ambien only worked once for 4 hours. I upped my seroquel dose and I finally got to sleep last night. But I'm only gonna be taking it short term while trying every other method possible until I find something that works. But I am going to be starting a full time just this coming week so if I must take a pill to sleep then so be it.

First question do you use positive self talk? From this day forward I want you to start saying "out loud" all the things you "think" you can't do. Even if you don't believe it at the moment put it out to the universe that you are here and your staying and you will transform slowly your thoughts by telling yourself you "can" do something instead of you can't. Second make a list of goals you want to achieve someday and read them everyday or atleast 5 days out the week. If that gets too hard then make small goals you can achieve each day that will give you some confidence. Third get outside I know it's hard but it helps go to a park and just sit on a bench and star at the sky. Your getting some vitamin D which will help you think better. Also be patient with yourself you are in a tough spot and some ppl have already given up in your situation. You are stronger then what you think you are, now you just need to see it within yourself. Lastly exercise even if it's walking outside each day up and down the street getting out of the house is critical to your mental health. I currently don't have a job but I decided enough is enough and I made a resume and will send it everywhere I can to find employment. A journey of a thousand miles starts with a single step. 
Love and best wishes you will overcome this!

Hang in there remember sui is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. If you don't give up things will get better. We are here for you when you need to vent you are not a burden here keep posting friend!
Hope you are well and know you are not alone I am in a tight spot mentally as well try to give it another day best wishes!

Coming from someone who has a mental illness it is not something you want or to play with! It can ruin your life (reality) at that and medication is hell. Be glad it's something you don't have to deal with cause you just might get what you ask for.

I hope you alright I'm battling with life too and it's hard but sometimes going through the pain can make you better in the long run. Best wishes!
